# What do you actually take home from Teachers Pay Teachers?

> Free Teachers Pay Teachers (TPT) seller earnings and fee calculator for teacher-authors: drop in your sales CSV and see the service fee actually taken, take-home per order, net revenue per product, repeat buyers, refunds, withdrawal costs, funds still clearing and the price needed for a target take-home.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
